text: Viction Retrodrop Season 1: By The Community, For The Community Home Website Twitter Sign in Subscribe Retrodrop Viction Retrodrop Season 1: By The Community, For The Community Viction 05 Jan 2025 • 3 min read Share The Background: Viction Improvement Proposal #2 Governance is at the core of Viction’s mission to empower its users. Recently, Viction Improvement Proposal #2 (VIP #2) concluded with overwhelming community participation. The proposal focused on defining the allocation priorities for VIC tokens in our Retrodrop program. After extensive deliberation and voting, the community chose to prioritize VIC stakers with a 40% allocation, recognizing their commitment to the network’s growth and stability. Active users and governance participants will receive 30% each, reflecting their vital roles in fostering activity and decision-making. How the Airdrop Works Retrodrop #1 sets the tone for what’s to come. Here’s a snapshot of the program: Distribution Scope: A total of 1,250,000 VIC tokens will be distributed to 178,000+ unique wallet addresses, rewarding those who have actively contributed to the network. Eligibility Check: Users can now visit retrodrop.viction.xyz to check if their wallets are eligible for this airdrop. Snapshot Period: The eligibility snapshot was taken from November 01, 2023 to September 22, 2024 (6AM, UTC+7) , capturing data from active participants, stakers, and governance contributors. This initiative underscores Viction’s commitment to transparency and rewarding meaningful engagement within the ecosystem. Reward Distribution The distribution aligns with the priorities outlined in VIP #2: By The Community, For The Community - 40% to VIC Stakers - 30% to Governance Participants - 30% to Active Users The tiered approach ensures that all stakeholders are valued while emphasizing contributions that drive Viction’s success. 1. 375,000 VIC to Governance participants 2. 375,000 VIC to Active Network Users (*) Eligibility is determined by minting activity during the snapshot period. (**) NFT holders snapshot taken on September 22, 2024. -These NFT collections include: - Gunstar Metaverse NFT EGG - Namyong - Some Ordinary Days - Artsasp x 12 Zodiac - Eternals - The Holy Cat - The Contrarians - Viction World Wide Chain - Bitcoin Halving: Viction Edition - Starship - Amphora: Viction Edition - Ivy - PIKALONG x DAGORA - Small Acts, Big Impact - Zen card NFT holder (Elemental II; Elemental V; Year of Long; GMVN) 3. 500,000 VIC to $VIC Stakers What’s Next? Retrodrop Season 1 is just the beginning. As we continue to celebrate and incentivize contributions, here’s what’s on the horizon: Enhanced Ecosystem Rewards: Future airdrops will explore additional ways to recognize diverse contributions across the network. Community Engagement Initiatives: New programs to amplify community involvement in governance and development. Retrospective Insight: A deeper dive into the data driving Viction’s decisions, ensuring every airdrop reflects the network’s evolving priorities. Viction Retrodrop Season 1 embodies our shared vision of building a collaborative and rewarding blockchain community. Head to retrodrop.viction.xyz to see if your wallet is eligible, and join us in celebrating this milestone.
